title: Billing and Coding: Frequency of Hemodialysis

codes.1: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. Medicare is establishing the following limited coverage for CPT/HCPCS code: 90999 (when reported to represent an extra dialysis session):

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10 Codes that Are Covered” section of this policy.
